"%1$s" at %2$s (port %3$d).

Check that the computer's pairing window shows the code %4$s.

Continue only if you started pairing on that computer.
Continue only if you started pairing on that computer and the code matches.
Could not reach %1$s at %2$s. The phone and the computer must be on the same network (or both on Tailscale), and the computer\'s firewall must allow PhoneBox.
%1$s did not accept the code: it works once and for 5 minutes. Start pairing again on the computer.
The computer has a different certificate than the QR code. Start pairing again.
Connect with a link or host

Paste the pairing link from the computer (Settings › Wi-Fi & Tailscale › Pair a phone over Wi-Fi › Copy pairing link), or enter the host (LAN, Tailscale MagicDNS, public IP, or DDNS), the same Wi-Fi port as on the computer, the certificate fingerprint and the one-time code. Remote hosts need Tailscale on both sides or a router port forward to the PC.
Or enter host, port and secrets
64 hex characters from the pairing window
From the pairing window (5 minutes, once)
Need a full pairing link, or a host, port, fingerprint and one-time code.
To update an existing pairing, enter the host, port and certificate fingerprint (or paste a link that has the fingerprint).
No paired computer matches that fingerprint. Use Connect with a one-time code first.
The panel can\'t run on this phone: Android could not start its WebView. Some Android 5 phones can\'t run the WebView versions PhoneBox needs.
